_note: Store profile and policy. Orders live in data/orders.csv (the demo shop export) plus anything imported in the app.

store.name: Page & Pine Books
store.description: Independent online bookshop shipping new and used books across the US.

policy.shipping: Orders ship within 1 business day via USPS Ground Advantage (2-5 business days). Every order gets a tracking number by email at dispatch.
policy.returns: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery in original condition. Buyer pays return shipping unless the item arrived damaged or was not as described.
policy.refunds: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 3 business days of receiving a return. If tracking shows no movement for 10 days, we reship or refund in full.
policy.digital: Gift cards and e-books are delivered by email instantly and are non-refundable once redeemed.
